forbidden_claims: A deployment record alone proves that payment-service v2 caused the incident.
A named third-party payment provider is confirmed globally unavailable.
Inventory or database failure caused the payment regression.

causal_chain: The scenario runner records a successful payment-service deployment from v1 to v2.
The deployment_regression fault makes payment-service v2 return PAYMENT_DEPLOYMENT_REGRESSION.
Payment error metrics, logs, and traces rise after the recorded deployment.
Checkout propagates the payment-service failure to the caller.
root_cause.summary: The successful payment-service v2 deployment is temporally correlated with a corroborated v2 error regression.
